evidence_snippets: In the directory where you downloaded the file, call the messages.create method to create the message in an HL7v2 store: curl To create an HL7v2 message, make a POST request and specify the following information: The name of the parent dataset The name of the HL7v2 store A message An access token The following sample shows a POST request using curl and a sample JSON file called hl7v2-sample.json . curl -X POST \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $( gcloud auth application-default print-access-token ) " \ -H "Content-Type: application/json;
